description: This file defines a report parser class for account balance reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving fiscal year, periods, and generating report lines.

classes.name: account_balance
classes.description: Report parser class for account balance report, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context variables and internal state.

methods.name: get_fiscalyear
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the fiscal year based on form input.

methods.name: get_periods
methods.description: Retrieves a string listing the periods based on form input.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates hierarchical account lines for the report, summing debits and credits.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Returns the total sum of credits.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Returns the total sum of debits.
